title: fix: only watch needed env files

expectedFindings.description: `getEnvFilesForMode` now returns absolute paths, but HMR still compares them to the bare `fileName`. Editing a .env file no longer restarts the dev server.

mustNotSkip.reason: The caller that wasn't updated for the new return value.
Changes what getEnvFilesForMode returns, from file names to joined paths.
Changes what the dev server watches.

evidence.note: Fix PR: "hmr for env files, regression from #15365". Compares against `file` (the full path) instead of `fileName`.
